title: Voice Shopping Assistant
tagline: Find and compare Shopify products through a voice conversation.
description: A voice AI shopping assistant built with Next.js and Agora Conversational AI that searches live Shopify listings and compares products against your budget. You can visit merchant websites from the results. Product discovery is read-only; the demo does not change carts, place orders or collect payments.
author: Agora

media.thumbnailAlt: ASCII illustration for Voice Shopping Assistant; supplied cover artwork, not a demo screenshot

setup.testRequest: Find running shoes under $100 that ship to the United States.
setup.configurationNote: Optional Shopify settings can remain empty for a limited anonymous trial.
